    Presiding Officer

  1. Welcome to the Suffolk County Legislature’s website. As Presiding Officer, I thank my colleagues for their confidence and their faith in me to preside over this legislative body; a separate and co-equal branch of Suffolk County Government. Together, we represent communities that expect results, demand accountability, and deserve leadership that puts people before politics.

    Legislator Greg Doroski honored Wading River Fire Department First Lieutenant Matthew Jakubowsky as the District 1 Volunteer Firefighter of the Year during a special Suffolk County Legislature ceremony. Read on...

  2. Recognizing Suffolk’s Champions of Diversity

    In recognition of Suffolk County’s diverse and inclusive population, April has been designated as “Champions of Diversity Month” and was marked with special presentations at the April 21st General Meeting of the Suffolk County Legislature in Hauppauge. Read on...
